elena: RCA posted for the serving-timeout incident earlier today — https://redwood.internal/rca/1793500000. Short summary: a kernel-level OOM on a GPU host during a sudden traffic burst caused a small set of Dedicated workers to become unresponsive; smart routing did not failover because the healthcheck window was too long for this failure mode. Impact: ~4 minutes of increased latency and ~1.2% error rate for affected customers.
elena: TL;DR root cause = host-level memory pressure + healthcheck config + an edge case in rollback logic. We validated model state and logs; no data exfiltration risk.
elena: Action items (owners & checkpoints):
```
- [ ] Reduce healthcheck grace period from 45s -> 10s (owner: mica) — due 2026-03-30
- [ ] Add host memory pressure alert + automatic node cordon (owner: ryan/eng-infra) — due 2026-04-06
- [ ] Add fallback routing test to CI (owner: jordan/eng-runtime) — due 2026-03-29
- [ ] Postmortem follow-up sync and customer comms draft (owner: sam-product) — due 2026-03-25
```
elena: I've attached the full RCA doc and the logs extract in the linked page. Please ack when you've taken ownership or filed a downstream ticket. @channel: flagged as P2 for Dedicated SLA impact. :warning:
ryan: acked. I'll create the infra ticket and start the alert rule change. Will ping when the cordon playbook is ready.
jordan: taking the runtime CI test. will prototype a synthetic failure test this week.
mica: will cut the healthcheck change in staging today, will roll to dedicated canary tomorrow.
sam-product: drafting customer-facing note — will share draft in #customer-success for review by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Incident archived: incident-2026-03-22-serving-timeout. RCA link: https://redwood.internal/rca/1793500000 (attached).
ryan: quick question — do we want automatic fallback to use the same model family or allow cross-family temporary swaps?
elena: good Q. For now stick to same-family variants to avoid drift; we'll evaluate cross-family policy as a separate workstream (added to backlog).
jordan: noted, will keep CI test limited to same-family fallback cases.
elena: planning a 30-minute follow-up check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT to confirm owners & verify staging healthchecks. Invite sent. Please add any blockers here. Thanks everyone! :heart:
